label: Flip-flop counts of common encodings
subgoals: Compute the ceiling of log base 2 of the state count for binary
Use one flip-flop per state for one-hot
Weigh flip-flop count against next-state logic size

label: Adjacency cost of an assignment
subgoals: Assign an affinity weight to each pair of states
Multiply each weight by the Hamming distance of the two codes
Sum the products to score the assignment

label: Exact choice for small machines
subgoals: Note that only the diagonal pairs change the cost in a two-bit code
Enumerate the three diagonal splits and pick the cheapest
Use heuristic encoders for larger machines
